# PennyOne and Hall Navigation

## Current Boundary

PennyOne projects bounded operator-visible state from Hall. Hall bead,
proposal, request, attempt, and validation records are lifecycle evidence;
PennyOne reports, dashboards, matrices, generated `.stats/` documents, and
scores are projections. They do not grant authority or prove current readiness.

Use `cstar-kernel` MCP first:

- `cstar_handoff` only when resuming prior state;
- `cstar_hall_search` for bounded lifecycle/document discovery;
- `cstar_status` for current bounded status; and
- `cstar_doctor` when health is unknown or degraded.

Use at most one broad Hall query before narrowing by bead id, target path, or
exact error. A stale or missing PennyOne projection is a freshness issue, not
permission to bypass CStar or scan the entire repository.

## CLI Compatibility

The `cstar pennyone`/`cstar p1` CLI may expose explicit read-only status, search,
or scan operations for terminal-required diagnosis. It is not a startup ritual
and must not automatically run a model, learn, harvest, mutate memory, launch a
daemon, or route execution.

## Score Boundary

Historical Logic, Style, Intel, Gravity, Gungnir, or intent-integrity values are
navigation hints only. A numeric claim has evidentiary standing only when the
actual scorer ran with a nonzero denominator, formula, exclusion accounting,
class coverage, row evidence, and an independent probe. Such evidence still
does not replace operator policy or CStar lifecycle state.

Persona may change professional tone and domain emphasis only. PMTs are
project-scoped information repositories, MM is legacy, and retired One Mind,
Ravens, AutoBot, or model-memory paths cannot be reactivated through PennyOne.
